scope: Corollary 6 (Compact Banach-space obstruction) of the manuscript “A doubling Hilbert subset with no finite-dimensional bi-Lipschitz embedding” (preprints/A-doubling-Hilbert-subset-with-no-finite-dimensional-bi-Lipschitz-embedding-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 098 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9c9b7e794d3a6630), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a universal constant Λ such that every infinite-dimensional real Banach space B contains a compact subset KB whose doubling constant is at most Λ and which admits no bi-Lipschitz embedding into any finite-dimensional real normed space at any finite distortion. The subset KB may depend on B, but is chosen independently of the target dimension and distortion.
